entries.name: Senior Alpaca Residents
entries.careFocus: Specialized nutrition, fleece care, and close monitoring through every season.
entries.story: Many of the sanctuary's alpacas arrive after major life changes or long periods without species-specific care. Their routines are built around gentleness, stability, and companionship.

entries.name: Llama Guardians
entries.careFocus: Large-space enrichment, hoof care, and individualized handling plans.
entries.story: Llamas are at the heart of Four Roots Ranch's rescue work. They often become calm anchors in mixed herds while receiving the patient rehabilitation they need.

entries.name: Pig Barn Crew
entries.careFocus: Warm bedding, safe shelter, hoof support, and soft-surface rest areas.
entries.story: The sanctuary's pigs require thoughtful daily management, especially in colder months. Their spaces are designed around comfort, routine, and practical accessibility.

entries.name: Sheep And Goat Herds
entries.careFocus: Balanced minerals, secure fencing, and herd-sensitive introductions.
entries.story: These residents thrive with careful social management and dependable nutrition. Their needs often overlap, but each herd still gets species-aware care and observation.

entries.name: Bird And Barnyard Flock
entries.careFocus: Predator-safe housing, weather protection, and flock-health checks.
entries.story: Four Roots Ranch also supports a lively barnyard flock whose care includes clean shelter, species-appropriate feed, and safe outdoor access.

entries.name: Cats And Companion Animals
entries.careFocus: Shelter, routine wellness support, and low-stress living spaces.
entries.story: Not every resident fits the same pattern, which is why the sanctuary's care model stays flexible. Individual needs shape each animal's forever-home plan.
